graph TD
    Start([Look at the data]) --> Q1{Answers to questions obvious?}
    Q1 -- Yes --> End([Use the results to answer the questions in your experimental objectives])
    Q1 -- No --> CreateModel[Create the theoretical model]
    CreateModel --> EstimateModel[Estimate the actual model from the data(simplify if possible)]
    EstimateModel --> Q2{Are the residuals randomly and Normally distributed around 0?}
    Q2 -- No --> TransformData[Try transforming the response data]
    TransformData --> Q2
    Q2 -- Yes --> Q3{Is there any Lack of Fit?}
    Q3 -- Yes --> IdentifyLoF[Use graphs to identify the source of the LoF. If feasible, edit the model to correct. If not, redesign or augment this design.]
    IdentifyLoF --> Q3
    Q3 -- No --> ExamineANOVA[Examine the ANOVA table]
    ExamineANOVA --> SimplifyModel{Further simplify the model if appropriate}
    SimplifyModel -- No --> End
    SimplifyModel -- Yes --> End

graph LR A["Phase I
